title: BTS FESTA 2026 Family Photo Released — First Full Group Anniversary Shoot Since Military Service Completion
detail: June 4, 2026 — Day 4 of BTS FESTA 2026: Big Hit Music releases the official BTS FESTA 2026 Family Photo — a beloved FESTA tradition marking its 13th consecutive year. The 2026 edition is the first anniversary family photo with all seven members (RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V, Jungkook) fully reunited since completing mandatory military service. The photos show all seven members in business-casual attire — laughing together on a sunlit outdoor lawn, piled informally on couches, and lined up on a staircase — capturing a relaxed and joyful dynamic consistent with the group's post-reunion energy. A behind-the-scenes video is released alongside the stills on Weverse and Bangtan TV YouTube. ARMY worldwide immediately notice how physically and emotionally at ease the members appear compared to the last in-person family photo before enlistments, a detail widely circulated on social media. The photo release trends globally across X (Twitter) and Instagram, with #BTSFamiPhoto2026 trending in 40+ countries. The 2026 family photo is particularly significant as it documents the full seven-member lineup midway through the ARIRANG World Tour — their first active world tour in four years — with anniversary concerts at Busan Asiad Main Stadium now 8 days away (June 12–13). Billboard calls it 'one of the most anticipated K-pop press photos of the decade.'

media.caption: BTS FESTA 2026 official family photo — the first full seven-member anniversary shoot since all members completed military service

title: ARIRANG World Tour Asia & Australia General On-Sale Opens — Kaohsiung, Melbourne, Sydney Tickets Available
detail: June 4, 2026: general on-sale tickets go live for the first cities of the ARIRANG World Tour Asia and Australia leg — following the ARMY MEMBERSHIP presale that opened June 2. Kaohsiung (National Stadium, Taiwan, November 19, 21–22), Melbourne (Marvel Stadium, Australia, February 12–13, 2027), and Sydney (Accor Stadium, February 20–21, 2027) enter general on-sale at respective local times. Demand for the Australian dates is intense: Sydney's Accor Stadium allocation sells through within minutes; Melbourne's Marvel Stadium allocation follows shortly after. Kaohsiung's National Stadium experiences similar sell-through speed for the two added dates. The rapid sell-through mirrors the experience of the North American and Japan legs, which all sold out in under 30 minutes. Queues of over 10,000 concurrent users are reported for the Ticketmaster Australia and Ticketmaster Taiwan sale pages. Additional Asia-Pacific cities (Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Bangkok, Jakarta, Hong Kong, Bulacan) have separate on-sale dates running through June 11. Fans locked out from the presale and general on-sale are encouraged to register for verified fan resale through official ticketing partners. The full Asia and Australia leg runs from November 19, 2026 through March 14, 2027 — the final chapter of the ARIRANG World Tour's 85+ date global itinerary.

media.caption: BTS ARIRANG World Tour Asia & Australia general on-sale opens June 4, 2026 — Kaohsiung, Melbourne, Sydney sell through rapidly
